q1.explanationZh: 女孩说一开始想做海洋（oceans），后来决定做世界上最大的几片沙漠（the largest deserts）。A 错：她改了主意；C 错：做森林主题的是男孩。

q2.explanationZh: Janine 说要先去图书馆取一本书（first I have to pick up a book from the library），Nathan 说 Then let’s go get it（那我们去取吧）。B 错：他们取完书才去餐厅吃午饭；C 错：化学课在午饭后，他们没说要去实验室。

q3.explanationZh: 女孩说下课后留下来，向 Patterson 老师请教没弄懂的历史作业，所以回家晚了。A 错：给同学打电话是她回家以后要做的事；B 错：篮球训练在明天。

q4.explanationZh: 男孩说爷爷给了他一本杂志，里面的文章有一些有趣的资料（some interesting facts），他已经找到的有用信息来自杂志。B 错：他在网上还没找到能用的东西；C 错：家里的书他打算接下来再看。

q5.explanationZh: 女孩说她要给每个人拍照，放在朋友的博客上（I’ve got to take photos of everyone）。B 错：烤蛋糕的是别人；C 错：弹吉他的也是别人（someone else）。

q6.explanationZh: 老师说导游叫 Jacob Jackster，并拼出了 J-A-C-K-S-T-E-R。表格里已经给出名字 Jacob，空格填姓 Jackster。

q7.explanationZh: 老师说导游的 T 恤是黄色的（his is yellow），所以很好认。red 不对：其他工作人员穿红色 T 恤。

q8.explanationZh: 老师说参观要花 45 分钟（it will take 45 minutes）。15 不对：那是参观开始前还要等的时间。

q9.explanationZh: 参观结束时每人会得到一份礼物，是一条围巾（It’s a scarf）。cap 和 mug 不对：那是礼品店里要自己买的东西。

q10.explanationZh: 老师说参观后会带大家去一个特别展览，可以看到画作（drawings），是俱乐部一名球员画的。artist 不对：它说的是画画的人，不是艺术的种类。

q11.explanationZh: 男士说这学期快结束了，但有一个假期课程（there’s a holiday course），Miriam 可以参加。B 错：他没提下学期的课；C 错：周末班已经满了（The weekend courses are full）。

q12.explanationZh: Miriam 说她的现代舞是高级水平（advanced level in modern），说明以前跳过很多现代舞。A 错：嘻哈她只有一点经验（a bit of experience）；C 错：她想学迪斯科，但一直没找到班。

q13.explanationZh: 男士说耳环和手镯很危险，要留在家里。耳环、手镯都属于首饰（jewellery）。A 错：平常的运动鞋可以穿；C 错：入学后学校会发一件印着校名的毛衣。

q14.explanationZh: 男士说有很多有名的歌曲可以用来跳舞，由学生决定用哪些（students decide which ones to use），也就是自己选舞曲。B 错：老师会给学生录像，不是看名人的视频；C 错：大家是一起跳（Everybody dances together），不是两人一组。

q15.explanationZh: Miriam 说她想参加学校的演出（I’d like to take part in your shows）。A 错：她只提到这里的老师很好，没说想当老师；B 错：她说对比赛不感兴趣。

q16.explanationZh: 女孩说爸爸答应让她上骑马课，她一直梦想学骑马，也就是学一项新运动。A 错：她们又要去西班牙（Spain again），不是新国家；B 错：姑姑明年才搬去纽约，爷爷这个夏天也不和她们一起去。

q17.explanationZh: 老师说原本要去图书馆，但天气很好，最好到户外去，可以坐在草地上看书，这是在公园。A 错：回教室前才去咖啡馆买饮料；B 错：老师改变了主意，不去图书馆了。

q18.explanationZh: 男孩说比萨饼太干了，他们忘了按时从烤箱里拿出来，也就是没烤好（badly cooked）。A 错：女孩说至少不贵；B 错：比萨是他们自己点的，男孩只是后悔没点沙拉。

q19.explanationZh: 女孩说住在隔壁的女士（the woman who lives next door，即邻居）丢了钥匙进不了家，她得回家找备用钥匙给她开门。B 错：她没提到同学；C 错：妈妈只是打电话告诉她，妈妈还在上班。

q20.explanationZh: 女孩问排球网和球在哪里，男孩说可能在车库，说明他们还得去找运动器材。A 错：做三明治的面包和奶酪已经买好了；C 错：气泡水也已经买了。

q21.explanationZh: Jason 说 Paul 的电脑坏了，但他有很多颜料大家都能用（he’s got lots of paints），所以 Paul 带颜料。B 错：他的电脑坏了，不会带来。

q22.explanationZh: Sara 说 Anna 读很多杂志，里面有很多零食等食物的广告，可以给海报找灵感，所以她会带杂志（she’s bringing those）。H 错：零食只是杂志里的广告内容。

q23.explanationZh: Sara 说 Tom 本想带妈妈的相机，但相机太贵了，所以只能带他的笔记本电脑（laptop），笔记本电脑就是一种电脑。A 错：相机太贵，不能带。

q24.explanationZh: Jason 说 Jenny 有一些橙汁，够大家喝（enough for us all），橙汁属于饮料。H 错：Jason 说不能带零食到学校。

q25.explanationZh: Sara 说要用剪刀，她家里有好几把（we’ve got several pairs at home），以前也带到学校用过，所以她带剪刀。E 错：她提到画画（a painting）只是在说上次带剪刀的时候，不是要带颜料。

content.v: Test Two. There are five parts to the test. You will hear each piece twice. We will now stop for a moment. Please ask any questions now because you must NOT speak during the test.
Now look at the instructions for Part One.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at question one.
One. What’s the subject of the girl’s geography project?
Isn’t your geography project about forests?
It’s only about one forest in South America. What’s yours about?
Well, first I wanted to do something about oceans, but then I decided to do it on some of the largest deserts in the world.
Cool. I think it’s amazing that plants and animals can live in places that have very little water.
Two. Where do the two friends decide to go first?
Hey Janine. Are you on your way to the cafeteria? They’re serving that really good pasta dish today!
Oh, hey Nathan. Yeah, but first I have to pick up a book from the library. I need it before the next lesson.
You mean for our chemistry class that’s after lunch? Then let’s go get it, so we can have lunch together.
Sure.
Three. Why has the girl come home late?
Jessica, why are you home so late? Isn’t basketball practice tomorrow after school?
That’s right, Dad. I had to stay after class to talk to Mrs Patterson about part of the history homework that I didn’t really understand.
Oh, that’s alright then.
Great. So now I need to call my classmates to give them the information.
Four. Where has the boy already found some useful information about elephants?
Jonathan, what are you doing on the internet?

I’m doing my homework, Mum. I’m looking for some information about elephants, but I haven’t found anything I can use yet. Grandpa gave me a magazine with an article with some interesting facts, but that’s all.
Well, we’ve got lots of books about animals. Have you checked any of those?
I’ll do that next.
Five. What will the girl do for her friend’s birthday party?
You’re going to Jessie’s birthday party soon, aren’t you?
Yeah, she doesn’t want anyone to give her gifts this year, Dad. Instead, she wants her friends to do different things for her party. I’ve got to take photos of everyone for her blog.
Will someone bake her a cake?
Yes, I think so. And someone else is going to play the guitar.
That is the end of Part One.
Now look at Part Two.
For each question, write the correct answer in the gap. Write one word or a number or a date or a time. Look at questions 6–10 now. You have 10 seconds.
You will hear a teacher telling a group of students about a tour of a sports stadium.
OK, class. Before we go inside the stadium, I just need to give you some information.
Your tour today is starting from the café. It’s just over there next to this entrance.
Your tour guide’s name is Jacob Jackster. That’s spelled J-A-C-K-S-T-E-R. He’ll be happy to answer questions today, or later by email, so write that down.
Different members of staff wear different colour T-shirts. Your guide will always be easy to see because his is yellow. All other members of staff wear a red T-shirt.
Your tour starts in 15 minutes and it will take 45 minutes, so I’ll meet you back here in one hour. OK?
At the end of the tour you’ll each get a present. It’s a scarf. You can also buy things like a cap or a mug in the gift shop later.
After the tour, I’ll take you to a special exhibition, where you can see drawings. These are by one of the club’s players, who is also a great artist.
That is the end of Part Two.
Now look at Part Three.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 11–15 now. You have 20 seconds.
You will hear a girl, Miriam, asking for information about jazz dance classes at a dance school.
Hello, can I join your jazz dance class?
We finish term soon but there’s a holiday course. It begins on Monday the 15th. The weekend courses are full I’m afraid.
OK. That’s alright.
Have you danced before?
I’m advanced level in modern and I’ve got a bit of experience doing hip hop. I wanted to do disco, but I never found a class.
That’s fine.
Is there anything I should or shouldn’t wear to class?
Your normal trainers are fine. But earrings or bracelets are dangerous, so leave them at home. You’ll get a sweater with the school name on it when you join.
What happens in class?
Everybody dances together. Sometimes we’ll film you to help you improve. There’s lots of famous songs to dance to, and students decide which ones to use.
Great!
So why do you want to learn jazz?
I know the school does jazz dance competitions – I’m not interested in that, but I’d like to take part in your shows. And someone told me the jazz teachers here are good!
That’s nice.
That is the end of Part Three.
Now look at Part Four.
For each question, choose the correct answer.
Sixteen. You will hear two friends talking about their holiday plans. What does the girl hope to do this summer?
What are your plans for the summer? I’m going to New York!

I’d love to go there! And I probably will ’cos my aunt’s going to move there next year. We’re going to Spain again. Dad’s promised I can have riding lessons. That’ll be fantastic! I’ve always dreamt of doing that. It’s a pity Grandpa’s not coming with us this summer.
Seventeen. You will hear a teacher talking to her class. Where does she want them to go now?

OK, I know I said we’d go to the library now but it’s such a lovely day that it’s better to be outside. You can sit on the grass and read your books. We’ll have to come back when Class 3 go there for football practice. But before coming back to the classroom you can get a drink from the café.
Eighteen. You will hear two friends talking in a café. What’s the problem with their food?
Are you enjoying this pizza?
Actually, I think it’s disgusting.
I don’t like it either. It’s really dry. I think they forgot when it was time to take it out of the oven. I’m sorry now that I didn’t choose the salad instead.
Me too. But at least it wasn’t expensive.
That’s true.
Nineteen. You will hear a girl leaving a message for a friend. Why is she going to be late?

Hi Josh. Sorry, I’ll be a bit late for our tennis class. Mum’s just called to tell me to go home after school. She can’t get off work but the woman who lives next door has lost her keys and can’t get in. We’ve got an extra set of keys at home. I’ve got to find them and let her in.
Twenty. You will hear a brother and sister talking about a picnic. What do they still need to do?
Hi Janet, have we got everything we need for the picnic?
Almost. I’ve got some bottles of sparkling water and all the things for the sandwiches – the rolls and the cheese were on special offer.
Great! Do you want to play volleyball before we eat?
Sure! But where’s the net? Oh, and the ball?
I think they’re in the garage.
That is the end of Part Four.
Now look at Part Five.
For each question, choose the correct answer. Look at questions 21–25 now. You have 15 seconds.
You will hear Sara and Jason talking about a meeting after school to make a poster for a project. What will each person bring to the meeting?
Hi Jason, everyone in our group’s bringing something for the meeting tomorrow.
Yes, to make a good poster, we’ll need some big pieces of paper, and I can bring that. My dad ordered some from an art magazine.
Great! And Paul?
His computer isn’t working but he’s got lots of paints that we can all use.
And Anna reads lots of magazines and they’ve got lots of adverts for snacks and things in them. I’m sure we’ll find some great ideas for our poster about food so she’s bringing those.
What’s Tom bringing?
He wanted to bring his mum’s camera but it’s a very expensive one, so he can only bring his laptop, but that’ll be useful.
And Jenny’s got some orange juice – enough for us all! But we mustn’t take snacks to school. That’s a pity! And what are you bringing, Sara?
We’ll need some scissors, and we’ve got several pairs at home. Remember, I brought them to school before when we had to do a painting of something from home?
Oh yeah – great!
That is the end of Part Five.
You now have six minutes to write your answers on the answer sheet.
You have one more minute.
That is the end of the test.
